auth.phone_hint: We'll send you a 6-digit code on WhatsApp. No password, no email.
auth.too_many_codes: Too many codes requested. Try again in :minutes minutes.
auth.code_hint: We sent it on WhatsApp to :phone. It's valid for 10 minutes.
auth.invalid_code: That code is wrong or expired. Check it or request a new one.
auth.no_club_title: You're not in a club yet
auth.no_club_body: You need an invitation to get in. Ask your team manager for the link.
empty.agenda: Upcoming matches and trainings will show up here, with the button to confirm if you're in.
empty.tabla: The league standings will show up here.
empty.vestuario: The team chat will show up here.
empty.cuota: Your monthly dues and the club's cashbox will show up here.
empty.perfil: Your player card will show up here: position, number and availability.
invite.hint: The link adds players to the club and expires after 7 days.
alta.name_q: How should we write you on the team sheet?
alta.name_hint: First and last name, as on your ID.
alta.pos_hint: You can change it later. It helps build the squad list.
alta.num_hint: It goes on both shirts. Crossed-out numbers are taken.
alta.slots_hint: Tick everything that works for you. We'll only ping you about those.
agenda.publish_hint: The call-up goes out to all :count squad players.
agenda.kit_note: The kit shown is the one to bring: red at home, sky blue away.
wa.reply_maybe: Marked as a maybe, :name. Let us know when you're sure.
cuota.covers: Covers pitch rental, referees, league registration and kit.
cuota.none: No dues generated for this month yet.
cuota.not_ready: The club hasn't enabled online payments yet. Settle with the manager as usual.
cuota.processing: We're confirming your payment. It'll show as paid shortly.
cuota.trust: Money goes to the association's account, not to a personal one.
cuota.stripe_body: Enable Stripe payments so the squad can pay dues from the app. Money goes straight to the club's account.
system.confirmed_match: :name is in for the match vs :opponent
